description: This file contains utility functions related to timer scheduling operations in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It primarily implements factory functions for creating timer descriptor objects, namely AnscCreateTimerDescriptor and its profiling variant.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateTimerDescriptor(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new timer descriptor object, invoking either the standard constructor or a profiling variant depending on compilation flags.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateTimerDescriptor2(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved,char * file,int line)
methods.description: Profiling variant of the timer descriptor creation function, capturing additional context such as file and line information.
